newsitem.title: USA: Reader's Digest sees lower Q3, year earnings.
newsitem.headline: Reader's Digest sees lower Q3, year earnings.

text.p: The Reader's Digest Association Inc said Monday it expects earnings for the third quarter and the year to be below market expectations.
The company said its full-year earnings, ended June 30, may be in a range of $1.70 per share to $1.80 per share.
Actual third quarter results are scheduled to be posted the end of April, the company said.

The company said lower-than-expected responses to many of its third-quarter promotional mailings in most markets hurt growth in the second half of the fiscal year as did a continuing weakness in European economies.
The First Call analysts' estimate for the year is $2.15 per share. For the third quarter, the First Call consensus estimate is $0.50 per share.
Reader's Digest, the publisher and direct marketer of magazines, books, music, videos and new media products, said it posted revenues of $3.1 billion for the fiscal year 1996.
